title: The scoreboard is the last to know.
body: Meet the model behind Read the Ice.

title: Goals lie.
body: A puck goes in off a skate, and a bad team looks good for a week. A perfect shot rings the post, and nobody remembers it.
We remember it. Our model watches what happens before the goal: who keeps getting the puck to the dangerous ice, and who is living on borrowed time.
Every unblocked shot of the last two seasons, each one scored on how often a shot like it becomes a goal.
Where it came from. What happened in the seconds before it. How fast the play developed.

title: What we won't sell you.
body: No locks. No guarantees. No five-star plays.
Hockey is a game of bounces, and anyone who tells you otherwise is selling something.
We hand you a number and the reason behind it. What you do with it is yours.
